---
name: Account page didn't parse
about: Credit Guard said it was signed in but couldn't read the account page
title: "Account page didn't parse on audible.<site>"
labels: parse-failure
---

If the extension offered a **Report this on GitHub** button, please use that
instead: it pre-fills this form with what the parser could and couldn't find
(every number masked). Otherwise, fill in what you can:

- Audible site (audible.co.uk / .com / .ca / .com.au / .in / other):
- Plan (1 credit a month / 2 a month / 12 a year / 24 a year / other):
- Membership active or paused:
- Credit Guard version (chrome://extensions) and Chrome version:

A screenshot of your account overview page with your name and balance blurred
is the single most useful thing. The wording Audible uses around the credit
balance and the next credit date is what the parser needs to learn.
